exercises.cardText:
Cable Row Bar Kneeling Crunch
Beginner
1
Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
2
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
3
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.
exercises.name: Cable Row Bar Kneeling Crunch

exercises.cardText:
Cable Standing Crunch
Intermediate

2

3

4

exercises.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Bayesian Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine.
3
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.
exercises.name: Cable Single Arm Bayesian Curl

exercises.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Hammer Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.
exercises.name: Cable Single Arm Hammer Curl

exercises.cardText:
Cable Pull In
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
2
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
3
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.
exercises.name: Cable Pull In

exercises.cardText:
Cable Twisting Curl
Advanced
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Start with a neutral grip. Flex at the elbow. While flexing twist your palm. When you hit the top of the movement your palm should be facing upward.
exercises.name: Cable Twisting Curl

exercises.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
2
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
3
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.
exercises.name: Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl

exercises.cardText:
Cable Seated Bilateral High Curl
Novice
1
Sit between high cables with arms extended outward and palms facing upward.
2
Curl both handles toward your head while keeping your upper arms stationary.
3
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly straighten your elbows.
exercises.name: Cable Seated Bilateral High Curl

exercises.cardText:
Cable Seated Alternating High Curl
Novice
1
Sit between high cables with your arms extended outward and palms upward.
2
Curl one handle toward your head while keeping your upper arm stationary.
3
Slowly extend your elbow, then repeat with the opposite arm.
exercises.name: Cable Seated Alternating High Curl

exercises.cardText:
Cable Standing Bilateral Pull In
Beginner
1
Stand between high cables, holding the handles in each hand.
2
Pull both elbows downward and inward toward your sides.
3
Squeeze your lats, then slowly extend your arms outward.
exercises.name: Cable Standing Bilateral Pull In

exercises.name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Pull In

exercises.cardText:
Cable Pull Around
Novice
1
Place cable pin all the way at the top or nearly at the top of the cable stack.
2
Face sideways and take a half kneeling position.
3
Grab the handle and reach across the body, begin the pull.
4
As you pull, imagine you are trying to put your elbow into your pocket.
exercises.name: Cable Pull Around

Stand sideways to cable and hold handle across your body at opposite side.
2
Pull handle outward and back, leading with elbow and keeping arm slightly bent.
3
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.
exercises.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row

exercises.cardText:

Novice
1
Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
2
Take an underhand grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
3
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

exercises.cardText:
Cable Chest Press
Novice
1
Use a handle attachment. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
2
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
3
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward.
4
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.
exercises.name: Cable Chest Press

exercises.cardText:

1
Set the cable pin at shoulder height or just above.
2
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
3
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
exercises.name: Cable Pec Fly

exercises.cardText:

Beginner
1

2
Squat down while keeping your chest raised and knees tracking outward.

Cable Belt Squat
Beginner
1
Put on a dip belt. Attach the strap/chain to the cable's carabiner.
2
Take a few steps back. Begin to squat by flexing at the knees and hips.
3
Let the weight pull you forward as you squat. Then push your toes through the front of your shoes as you squat back to the start position.
exercises.name: Cable Belt Squat

exercises.cardText:
Cable Belt Split Squat
Beginner
1
Put on a dip belt and attach the strap/ chain to the cable's carabiner.
2
Take a few steps back and take a split stance.
3
Lower into a split squat, letting the weight pull you forward. As you squat back to the starting position push yourself backwards against the resistance.
exercises.name: Cable Belt Split Squat

exercises.cardText:
Cable Seated Leg Extension
Beginner
1
Use an ankle/wrist attachment. Pull the cable under the bench and attach it at your ankle.
2
Extend at the knee against the cable.
exercises.name: Cable Seated Leg Extension

exercises.cardText:
Cable Zercher Squat
Intermediate
1
Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
2
Place the bar in your elbows, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
3
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
4
Squat all the way back to a standing position.
exercises.name: Cable Zercher Squat

exercises.cardText:
Cable Rope Face Pulls
Novice
1
Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
2
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
3
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.
exercises.name: Cable Rope Face Pulls

exercises.cardText:
Cable High Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
2
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
3
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.
exercises.name: Cable High Single Arm Rear Delt Fly

exercises.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row
Advanced
1
Use a handle attachment, grab with an overhand grip and take a position with the cable crossing your body.
2
Pull your elbows back while flaring your elbows outward.
exercises.name: Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row

exercises.cardText:
Cable Supinating Row
Beginner
1
Place the cable at shoulder height.
2
Start with an overhand grip. As you pull your elbow back, rotate your palm until it faces upward.
exercises.name: Cable Supinating Row

exercises.cardText:
Cable Archer Row
Intermediate
1
Place the cable at shoulder height.
2
On the same side as the working arm, step back and rotate outwards.
3
Pull your elbow back while flaring your elbow out.
exercises.name: Cable Archer Row

exercises.cardText:
Cable Rope Kneeling Face Pull
Novice

Start with the cables at the top. Use a rope attachment. Fall to a half kneeling position.
2
Pull the metal piece in the middle of the rope to the bridge of your nose.
exercises.name: Cable Rope Kneeling Face Pull

3

2

3

exercises.cardText:
Cable Silverback Shrug
Novice
1
Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
2
Stand up with the attachment in hand, walk a couple of steps back make sure you are standing upright and not leaning backwards.
3
Retract your shoulder blades and then protract to return to the starting position.
exercises.name: Cable Silverback Shrug

exercises.cardText:
Cable 30 Degree Shrug
Beginner
1
Use a handle attachment on both sides of crossover. With cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
2
Grab both handles and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arms hang freely.
3
Pull your shoulder blades up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blades depress back to the starting position.
exercises.name: Cable 30 Degree Shrug

exercises.cardText:
Cable Upright Row
Advanced
1
Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
2
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.
exercises.name: Cable Upright Row

2
Stand in the center of the machine holding each Cable in the opposing hand. Your upper arm should be at a 45 degree angle with your torso.
3
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction and then return to the starting position
exercises.name: Cable Cross Pushdown

exercises.cardText:

Beginner
1

2
Point your elbows straight up toward the ceiling.
3
From there, extend your elbows until your fists are pointed straight toward the ceiling.
exercises.name: Cable Rope Overhead Tricep Extension

3
